revision_reason: Switches both members from the amazon route to their own Bazaarvoice deployments, and replaces one Amazon ASIN per member with the product families the platform actually pools reviews into: Traeger 7, Weber 5, measured 2026-10-17 as 12 distinct families with zero review-id overlap between any pair. The reason is depth and cadence, not anything about either company: Amazon caps a pass at about 100 reviews per filter combination, which on these grills buys weeks rather than years, while Traeger's own deployment serves 7.6 years at 97-100% text with no cap and a newest review 5 days old. No member, brand, concentration figure or substitutability reason changed, and no review has been collected for this group - readings_at_declare is 0, so this is still declared before collection as section 2 requires. Carried findings: two of the seven Traeger families are served In Store Only and are declared for the history they hold, not for new sales, so a withdrawal ends that family's series rather than being swapped; and Weber's text fraction has fallen from 100% in 2019 to 29-37% now, so its scored population is a shrinking minority of its rated one and must be reported with every Weber reading.
substitutability_test: Would a consumer shopping for this seed's product consider this company's product instead of it, as a direct alternative for the same need, at the same point of purchase? If yes, it is a peer. Size, country, listing venue and currency are irrelevant to the answer.
